home.eyebrow: {count, plural, one {# component} other {# components}} · MIT core
home.intro: Fasla is a React component library from Smicolon GmbH, built on shadcn/ui primitives. The CLI copies a component's source into your project — you own it, you edit it, there is no black box to fight.

terminal.title: terminal
terminal.ownership: edit it · rename it · delete it

stats.componentsLabel: components across primitives, blocks and effects
stats.depsLabel: required runtime deps beyond your own React
stats.countryLabel: Built in Germany by Smicolon GmbH

registry.title: What is in the registry
registry.intro: Three categories, one install path. Every component ships its loading, empty, error and disabled states.

primitives.title: UI primitives
primitives.description: Button, Input, Card, Badge, Skeleton, Avatar, Checkbox, Switch, Select, Combobox, Tabs, Textarea.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: AppShell, PageHeader, EmptyState, Sidebar, Navbar, StatsCard, DataTable, FormSection.

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: ShimmerButton, AnimatedGradient, TextReveal, BorderBeam, Spotlight, GlowCard, TypewriterText.

accessible.title: Accessible by default
accessible.description: Keyboard navigation and screen reader support are built in. Icon-only buttons carry an aria-label; focus styles stay visible.

motion.title: Reduced motion respected
motion.description: Every animation reads prefers-reduced-motion from the shared motion presets. No opt-in required.

typescript.title: TypeScript throughout
typescript.description: Typed props and variants, so autocomplete works the moment a component lands in your project.

tokens.title: Semantic tokens
tokens.description: Colours come from CSS variables and the Tailwind theme. Retheme the set by editing tokens, not components.

density.title: Three density profiles
density.description: Compact, comfortable and spacious, so the same components suit a dense console and a marketing page.

ownership.title: Yours after install
ownership.description: The CLI copies source, not a dependency. Nothing stops you rewriting a component the day after you add it.

landing.introBody: Fasla provides a collection of reusable components that you can copy and paste into your apps. It's not a traditional component library — you own the code and can customize it however you want.
landing.getStartedBody: Install the CLI and add your first component.

features.components: {count}+ components — UI primitives, app blocks, and effects
features.accessible: Accessible — built with accessibility in mind, keyboard navigation included
features.animated: Animated — smooth animations with Framer Motion, respects reduced motion
features.darkMode: Dark mode — dark mode support out of the box
features.customizable: Customizable — built with Tailwind CSS, easy to customize
